OverviewFeaturesUse casesPricingTradeoffsCompatibilityFAQ

What is Suno?

Text-to-music generator producing complete songs with vocals, lyrics, instrumentation and structure from a prompt. Widely considered the leading consumer music generator for full vocal tracks.

Best for

Complete songs with vocals generated from a text description.

Main features

  • Full song generation with vocals from a text prompt
  • custom lyrics input or AI lyric writing
  • genre, mood and style prompting
  • Personas for consistent artist voice across tracks
  • Covers reinterpreting an existing track in a new style
  • Extend and Remaster
  • stem separation on higher tiers
  • audio upload to continue or transform
  • Studio editor for arrangement
  • commercial rights on paid tiers.

Practical use cases

  • Generating background music for video for a project, subject to applicable usage terms
  • creating a jingle or advert track
  • producing demo tracks to explore an idea
  • podcast intros and stingers
  • original songs for personal projects.

Who is it for?

  • Content creators, indie musicians, advertisers, game developers, podcasters and hobbyists.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium credit-based subscription

Plans described in the source

Free/Basic $0 with roughly 50 credits per day (about 10 songs), non-commercial use only. Pro around $10/mo ($8 annually) with roughly 2,500 credits/month (about 500 songs), commercial use rights and 10 concurrent generations. Premier around $30/mo ($24 annually) with roughly 10,000 credits/month (about 2,000 songs) and priority. Enterprise available. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with daily credit refresh, but strictly non-commercial.

Free trial

Free tier serves as the trial.

Usage limits to consider

Credit-metered, roughly 5 credits per song generation (each generation typically produces two variants). Free tier credits reset daily and cannot be used commercially. Stem separation and some features are paid-tier only.

Confirm current plans and pricing ↗

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Vocal quality and song coherence are the best available - complete, structured, listenable songs from a prompt is genuinely impressive
  • very cheap for the output volume
  • commercial rights included at $10/mo
  • Personas give consistency across a project.

Limitations to consider

  • limited fine-grained control over arrangement compared with a DAW
  • no MIDI export
  • output can sound generic and recognisably AI-generated
  • stem separation quality varies
  • no official API.
  • Review the current usage terms for your plan and intended use before distributing generated music.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android
  • Discord

Languages

  • Lyrics and vocals in many languages including Arabic and French, though English is strongest

API access

Limited official API; third-party wrappers exist but are unofficial

Integrations and exports

  • Direct export to MP3/WAV
  • sharing to social platforms
  • no deep DAW integration

The source includes legal and licensing commentary that has not been independently assessed here. Refer to the current official terms for plan-specific usage conditions.
